jobs.title: Program Manager, Aircraft
jobs.description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. Our aircraft work is scaling fast. Our Group 5 aircraft program runs alongside a growing set of research programs, with design, build, supply chain, and test all moving in parallel. We need one strong Program Manager to lead program management across all of it. You will join our Program Management Office, reporting to the Director of PMO. You will take full ownership of our research programs and partner with the Director to run the aircraft program, owning cost, schedule, scope, risk, and the customer relationship. You will be the person who knows where every aircraft effort actually stands on any given day. What you'll do • Own our research programs end to end as the primary point of contact for government program managers and contracting teams • Drive program execution on our aircraft program with the Director of PMO, from design reviews through fabrication, integration, ground test, and flight test • Build and maintain the integrated master schedule (IMS) across both efforts, tied to contract milestones and test events • Own budgets and burn, track against funding, and flag variance early with a recovery plan • Deliver contract requirements on time: CDRLs, monthly status and financial reports, technical reports, and final deliverables • Run the program cadence: weekly reviews, technical interchange meetings, milestone review
